species.name: Symphonia globulifera
species.role: Habitat structure, shade and forest diversity
species.source: SNGF or a district-licensed native nursery; request seed-origin record.
species.method: Use locally collected, legally sourced nursery stock only in a mapped historical humid-forest restoration plot. Local botanist sets handling and spacing.
species.care: Mulch away from stem; protect from fire, trampling and cyclone damage.
species.monitor: Tag seedlings; inspect canopy damage and 12-month survival.
species.caution: Local range, wetness, taxonomy and provenance require on-site verification.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Ravenala madagascariensis
species.role: Existing eastern-forest mosaic and agroforestry structural diversity
species.source: SNGF or local indigenous nursery; verify provenance and site range.
species.method: Raise verified nursery seedlings; use only within documented natural range on disturbed humid-forest edges where restoration specialists advise.
species.care: Water during establishment if needed; protect from cyclone exposure.
species.monitor: Recruitment, mortality, seed spread and wildlife use.
species.caution: Do not assume natural range extends to any Madagascar district; avoid mass single-species planting.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Intsia bijuga
species.role: Long-lived coastal/littoral forest tree where locally indigenous
species.source: SNGF/native community nursery, only site-matched local genotype.
species.method: Specialist nursery propagation; restore into verified historical littoral/coastal forest behind appropriate setback.
species.care: Protect from salt spray beyond tolerance, encroachment and fires.
species.monitor: Tag growth and canopy recovery at 6 and 12 months.
species.caution: Slow-growing; may face harvest pressure; jurisdictional protection and provenance check needed.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Vanilla planifolia
species.role: Income diversification under an existing multistory farm canopy
species.source: Certified clean cuttings from established local producers/cooperatives; verify phytosanitary health.
species.method: Plant healthy cuttings at base of locally approved support trees in existing shaded fields; ensure drainage and expert pruning practice.
species.care: Use shade management, mulch, clean tools and sanitation; watch Fusarium root/stem rot.
species.monitor: Vine survival, disease, labor, flowering and net household income.
species.caution: Non-native commercial crop; no conversion of remaining forest to vanilla plantations.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Theobroma cacao
species.role: Shade-grown household income on existing farmland
species.source: Local nursery or established grower cooperative offering selected disease-free plants.
species.method: Use existing cultivated land with layered, preferably native shade; transplant at rainy season with drainage and tested cultivars.
species.care: Weed/mulch; monitor shade, black-pod disease, pests and soil fertility.
species.monitor: Fruit yield, tree disease, shade diversity and cost of care.
species.caution: Do not expand by clearing native forest; not adapted to cool uplands or dry south.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Zingiber officinale
species.role: Short-cycle cash/food crop in existing garden land
species.source: Existing local agricultural input/cooperative suppliers of disease-free rhizomes.
species.method: Plant sound rhizome pieces in prepared raised beds with mulch and rain-fed moisture; agree local spacing with extension agent.
species.care: Maintain drainage; remove rotting plants; rotate and avoid contaminated planting stock.
species.monitor: Stand establishment, rot symptoms and harvest volume.
species.caution: Contain in existing farm boundaries; do not plant in forest understory.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Uapaca bojeri
species.role: Native fire-tolerant tapia woodland, edible fruits, wild-silk habitat
species.source: SNGF or authorized tapia-conservation nursery, with local genetic provenance.
species.method: Only reinforce documented tapia woodland or suitable recovery mosaic under local woodland management, not a blanket tree plantation.
species.care: Protect regeneration from recurring destructive fires, livestock browse and harvesting pressure.
species.monitor: Natural seedlings, landibe moth habitat, grazing compatibility and tree survival.
species.caution: Tapia woodland is an ecosystem with local rights and special management; do not overplant.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Podocarpus madagascariensis
species.role: Native forest diversity in suitable highland forest remnants
species.source: SNGF offers this taxon in its forest seedling listings; confirm exact species and geographic provenance.
species.method: Nursery-raised planting only inside appropriate restored native forest, after local range survey.
species.care: Protect shade/moisture for young plants; prevent soil disturbance.
species.monitor: 12-month survival, natural recruitment and wildlife recovery.
species.caution: Species-specific forest requirement and protected status require verification.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Phaseolus vulgaris
species.role: Protein and nitrogen contribution within crop rotation
species.source: FOFIFA/SOC-accredited crop seed providers, matching altitude and variety.
species.method: Sow tested local cultivar in cultivated plots at first reliable rain; follow packet or extension row-depth recommendations.
species.care: Weed early; maintain rotation, control bean disease and drain saturated soil.
species.monitor: Germination, pod yield, pests and soil cover.
species.caution: This is a crop, not a forest-restoration species.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Ipomoea batatas
species.role: Nutrition and field coverage on suitable cultivated land
species.source: Disease-free local vine cuttings from agricultural nursery or farmer seed network.
species.method: Set cuttings on cultivated ridges or beds once moisture sufficient; choose locally tested cultivar.
species.care: Weed, protect cuttings from grazing, manage weevils, ensure adequate establishment moisture.
species.monitor: Tuber harvest, vine survival, weevil damage and dietary use.
species.caution: Use managed farmland; sweet potato is not appropriate as a habitat restoration introduction.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Solanum tuberosum
species.role: Cooler-highland calories and livelihood diversification
species.source: SOC-authorized supplier or FOFIFA-linked disease-free seed potatoes.
species.method: Plant certified tubers into cultivated well-drained highland beds in locally recommended season.
species.care: Hill soil, rotate crops and promptly remove blight-infected leaves as advised.
species.monitor: Yield, blight incidence, storage loss and input cost.
species.caution: Avoid seed potatoes of unknown disease status.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Dalbergia greveana
species.role: Ecological restoration of site-matched dry forests; habitat diversity
species.source: SNGF lists this species; obtain legal-origin plants and paperwork directly.
species.method: Use local-origin, legally documented nursery plants only as part of native-species mix in verified natural range.
species.care: Protect seedlings against fire, grazing and illegal cutting.
species.monitor: Survival and anti-harvest safeguards, with no public precise GPS for rare plants.
species.caution: High conservation/harvest sensitivity; NEVER trade wild seed or wood without legal clearance.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Cordyla madagascariensis
species.role: Canopy diversity in western dry and transitional forest
species.source: SNGF/native local nursery; ask district botanist to identify suitable seed stands.
species.method: Raise stock from approved local sources; plant into verified historical forest with firebreak and browsing plan.
species.care: Establish at rains; mulch where sensible; keep invasive grasses from seedlings.
species.monitor: Annual survival, growth and return of natural vegetation.
species.caution: Locally verify occurrence and soil before moving planting material between districts.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Abrahamia ditimena
species.role: Local dry forest reconstruction with Malagasy endemic flora
species.source: Locally sourced permitted tree nursery; confirm updated taxon name before purchase.
species.method: Seed/nursery protocol only after practitioner confirmation; favor assisted natural regeneration if seedlings present.
species.care: Exclude damaging fire/grazing; monitor natural recovery.
species.monitor: New native recruits, survival and competitive invasive plants.
species.caution: Sometimes listed by old name Protorhus ditimena; do not purchase unidentified Protorhus spp.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Sorghum bicolor
species.role: Drought-tolerant grain crop and household food
species.source: SOC-accredited district seller; ask specifically for approved IRAT 204, MACIA or region-registered variety where suitable.
species.method: Direct seed into moisture-bearing existing fields following local certified seed packet and soil profile; test small plots first.
species.care: Weed in first weeks; control birds and striga where present; avoid water stress at flowering where feasible.
species.monitor: Emergence, days to maturity, grain weight, household consumption and yield per hectare.
species.caution: A drought-tolerant crop is not drought-proof; regional approval and real water budget still matter.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Vigna unguiculata
species.role: Protein, soil cover and crop rotation
species.source: SOC-accredited seed producers; Boeny varieties include Black eyes and Zazamena, verify local approval.
species.method: For erect cultivars an IITA starting reference is 50 cm between rows × 20 cm plants; adapt locally. Sow 2–3 viable seeds per station, thin per cultivar guidance.
species.care: Control early weeds and insects; dry harvested seed well; rotate with cereals.
species.monitor: Germination, pods, dry seed yield, insect damage and dietary use.
species.caution: Spacing depends on variety (vining types need more space); seed quality and land suitability first.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Adansonia grandidieri
species.role: Endemic local-range habitat recovery and long-term genetic conservation
species.source: SNGF/approved conservation partners only, with local authorization and provenance.
species.method: Only specialist planting within its narrow southwestern coastal dry forest range; prioritize safeguarding adults and natural seedlings.
species.care: Establish during adequate rain; protect from grazing, fire and illegal removal.
species.monitor: Existing adults, recruit survival, seed origin and long-term habitat trend.
species.caution: Not a general drought tree for the rest of Madagascar; endangered/high-conservation-value.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Adansonia za
species.role: Native woodland structure and biodiversity where locally indigenous
species.source: SNGF or registered Malagasy endemic-tree nursery; request precise permitted provenance.
species.method: Raise approved seedlings only for locales with verified natural occurrence, ideally in mixed native woodland restoration.
species.care: Protect saplings from browsing and fire over multiple seasons.
species.monitor: Annual survival, regeneration and fruiting of mature local stock.
species.caution: Do not mix separate district genetic populations indiscriminately.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Vigna subterranea
species.role: Resilient grain legume, nutritional diversity
species.source: SOC seed producers or local crop cooperative with region-appropriate verified seed.
species.method: Sow into prepared existing farmland as rainy season starts; plant spacing and maturity based on local cultivar.
species.care: Weed during establishment; avoid waterlogging and rotate crops.
species.monitor: Germination, food availability and grain storage losses.
species.caution: Suitability of a particular cultivar under very low rain remains unverified until trials.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Sesamum indicum
species.role: Potential low-input cash/food oilseed
species.source: SOC-authorized seed dealer if approved variety is documented in district.
species.method: Pilot only in an existing well-drained plot during reliable rainfall, subject to local extension guidance.
species.care: Keep weed-free early; protect maturing capsules and dry promptly.
species.monitor: Seed yield, disease, market price and labor.
species.caution: Availability/registration in a given district is not confirmed here.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Alluaudia procera
species.role: Structure and habitat continuity in Madagascar’s spiny thicket
species.source: Authorized local conservation nursery only; verify Didiereaceae permits and origin.
species.method: Do not transplant from the wild; specialist nursery restoration only on verified indigenous spiny-forest sites.
species.care: Shield from herbivory and fire, avoid excessive irrigation and disturbance.
species.monitor: 12-month survival, recruitment and adjacent endemic flora.
species.caution: Didiereaceae are regulated; never advertise online wild collection or unscreened trade.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Didierea madagascariensis
species.role: Conserve threatened arid thorn-forest habitat
species.source: Authorized endemic-species conservation programme and local community nursery.
species.method: Conservation-led propagation only after district-level habitat, legal and genetic review.
species.care: Prefer protection of naturally regenerating plants; careful establishment irrigation by local expert.
species.monitor: Plant survival and vegetation composition rather than tree-count targets.
species.caution: Spiny-thicket specialist, protected movement restrictions; not ornamental export project.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Moringa drouhardii
species.role: Specialist recovery of southern/southwestern native vegetation
species.source: Authorized local native-tree nursery or botanist; confirm natural range.
species.method: Pilot with site-matched endemic nursery stock on degraded native habitat only after expert advice.
species.care: Exclude livestock pressure, watch for drought mortality in first two seasons.
species.monitor: Survival, wild recruitment and habitat fit.
species.caution: Do not confuse with introduced Moringa oleifera or assume the same edible uses.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Arachis hypogaea
species.role: Food, oil, diversified crop rotation
species.source: SOC-approved seed network; Boeny approvals include Marabe, Menakely and Menabe, but confirm southern suitability.
species.method: Sow clean, locally recommended seed into soil with reliable early moisture in existing crop plots.
species.care: Weed/earth up as advised, dry pods on clean surfaces; avoid mold during storage.
species.monitor: Pods, aflatoxin-prevention practices, household consumption and soil erosion.
species.caution: Requires rain during establishment; poor drying can cause serious food-safety hazards.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Cajanus cajan
species.role: Perennial legume for managed field margins and edible pulses
species.source: Regionally established crop-seed producer via SOC directory or FOFIFA partner; confirm allowed variety.
species.method: On farm boundaries only: test 1 m between rows, 30–50 cm in-row for a standalone crop and 2.5–4 cm sowing depth as general FAO reference.
species.care: Protect seedlings from browse; prune only with local guidance; manage pod pests.
species.monitor: Household harvest, survival and any escape outside field perimeter.
species.caution: Woody legume with potential to persist/spread; avoid near natural habitat without ecological assessment.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Manihot esculenta
species.role: Drought-season calories once established in suitable field
species.source: Disease-free cuttings from Malagasy approved local crop nursery or farmer network.
species.method: Plant viable stakes in existing fields at start of reliable rain; follow local cultivar and spacing advice.
species.care: Weed first months; manage mosaic disease; avoid exhausting poor soils.
species.monitor: Yield, root rot, plant health and household cooking protocols.
species.caution: Some varieties have high cyanogenic compounds: safe processing is essential; never consume raw roots/leaves.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Rhizophora mucronata
species.role: Tidal mangrove recruitment in locally suitable elevations
species.source: Nearby community-run mangrove nursery/approved restoration group; e.g. ADRA MIATRIKA project area.
species.method: First re-establish tidal exchange and natural propagule recruitment; plant local propagules only in matched tidal zones when experts determine needed.
species.care: Protect tidal channels from blockage and propagules from trampling.
species.monitor: Tidal exposure, sediment level, natural recruits, survival and shoreline change.
species.caution: Planting into seagrass, tidal mudflats or unsuitable elevations can cause harm and fail.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Avicennia marina
species.role: Mangrove zone diversity, saline-site recruitment
species.source: Existing Madagascar community nursery with local seed provenance.
species.method: Ecological hydrology first; restore only in correct local elevation and salinity zone; support natural regeneration if present.
species.care: Monitor water flows, avoid cutting channels and grazing.
species.monitor: Recruitment by tidal band and seedling health.
species.caution: Do not assume tolerance means suitable for every bare coastal flat.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Ceriops tagal
species.role: Tidal-gradient diversity and mangrove recovery
species.source: Local coastal nursery linked to local restoration programme, with permission.
species.method: Species-specific position on tidal gradient selected by local restoration team; no blanket seedling grids.
species.care: Track tidal connectivity, freshwater inflow and propagule survival.
species.monitor: Survival by elevation, creek connection and natural regeneration.
species.caution: Only in historically mangrove-appropriate sites; protect intertidal non-mangrove habitat.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Sonneratia alba
species.role: Mangrove species diversity along suitable coast
species.source: Approved local mangrove nursery or community-collected propagules under authorization.
species.method: Use only where hydrodynamics and substrate match existing local Sonneratia stands.
species.care: Protect estuarine water flows, monitor erosion and water quality.
species.monitor: Presence of natural recruits, seedling survival and fish habitat.
species.caution: Expert identification important; no mass planting on open tidal flats.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Oryza sativa
species.role: Staple food in existing rice production systems
species.source: FOFIFA certified varieties via SOC-accredited sellers and regional research stations.
species.method: Only within legally existing paddy systems; choose locally recommended irrigated or rain-fed variety, seedbed and planting schedule.
species.care: Manage irrigation judiciously; protect natural marsh edges, soil and downstream water users.
species.monitor: Grain yield, irrigation volume and wetland boundary integrity.
species.caution: Never drain natural marshes or clear swamp forest to expand rice.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Colocasia esculenta
species.role: Diverse starch crop in established moist gardens
species.source: Locally produced clean corms/planting pieces with agricultural extension advice.
species.method: Plant only in already-cultivated moist plots with controlled water, separate from native marshes.
species.care: Manage pests and water; cook edible parts properly, monitor wetland escape.
species.monitor: Plant yield, flood damage and native wetland vegetation.
species.caution: Can spread or escape in wet places; raw taro is irritating/toxic and requires proper cooking.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Native sedges & riparian assemblages (locally identified)
species.role: Protect soil, wetland bird habitat, filtration and water retention
species.source: Local wetland plant conservation nursery after species-specific identification and authorization.
species.method: Protect wetland hydrology and natural colonisation; plant only named, surveyed local species where required.
species.care: Remove invasive water hyacinth by approved programmes; reduce grazing/contamination.
species.monitor: Native plant cover, wetland water levels, invasive cover and water quality.
species.caution: Not a retail species: avoid importing foreign sedge or reed mixes.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Locally native grasses and forbs
species.common: Site survey, not purchased grass mix
species.role: Protect ancient grassland biodiversity, grazing and belowground carbon
species.source: Local botany teams and pastoral communities; do not order generic imported grass seed.
species.method: Survey grassland origin, indigenous species and pastoral rights before any intervention; support natural grass recovery where degraded.
species.care: Reduce damaging erosion/fire pressures as locally agreed; retain necessary grazing access.
species.monitor: Native cover, soil stability, infiltration and livestock access.
species.caution: Tree planting can damage ancient grassland ecosystems.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.

species.name: Local Erica / Helichrysum communities
species.role: Conserve rare upland vegetation and watershed function
species.source: No consumer purchase recommended; specialists and protected-area managers only.
species.method: No planting campaign until native species, microhabitat and climate exposure are surveyed.
species.care: Limit trampling, fire, invasive plants and erosion.
species.monitor: Vegetation transects, soil disturbance and species composition.
species.caution: High-elevation species cannot be generalized across massifs.
species.season: Local onset of reliable rains; avoid storms and waterlogging.
